body:
# OWNER GO — Codex1 RA-3D D1/D2: Source compatibility and executable OFFLINE review contract

**Authorization:** 2026-11-12. This is the **new, separately issued, bounded RA3D source-code GO** after Owner FINAL PASS and exact-SHA merge of RA3C functional PR47, independent QA PR48 and design-only RA3D Phase0 PR50. NOT permission for any live human approval, production runtime, share or customer access.

## Accepted baseline and technical owner
- Accepted GitHub `main` at issue creation: `e40201bf399cc8c5d11a708fcbe33c31f01e67b2` (PR48 merge `e40201b...`, PR48 QA head `5cc32291c9f215c16b9998cbcbe5ceffe448a4cb`). Re-read `origin/main` on entry and normal-merge any subsequently accepted changes before final CI. No rebase/force.
- Read already merged RA3D Phase0 `CONTRACT.md`, `DESIGN_DECISIONS.md` DD01–DD14, `THREAT_MATRIX.md`, `TEST_PLAN.md` A01–A48, `SCENARIOS.md`; current merged `vrae/reporting/{draft,editorial,renderer}.py`, `vrae/domain/{reviews,access}.py`, schemas `contracts/v1/{ReportVersion,ReviewDecision,ShareGrant}.schema.json`; RA3C QA V2 is current accepted regression. Previously frozen Phase0 design's old provisional RA3C SHA is not the current main API. No updates to frozen design or Gold.
- Codex2 exclusively owns active Issue #55 / PR #56 Chinese reviewer-first UX; keep fully separate. Codex1 uses NEW independent worktree+branch `codex1/ra3d-d1d2-offline-review-contract` and new Draft PR.

## Authorized path ownership
- NEW pure Python package ONLY `vrae/reviewing/**` (not `vrae/domain/reviews.py`); new dedicated tests ONLY `tests/reviewing/**`; new D1/D2 specs and evidence ONLY `docs/03-engineering/ra3d-d1d2-offline/**`.
- DO NOT modify existing production code, reporting, Guard/rules/evidence, frozen RA0 schemas/OpenAPI, any current tests/CI, pyproject, `.dockerignore`, Dockerfiles/dependencies, RA3C historical QA or Phase0/0.5/0.6 documents and screenshots. If necessary changes would escape these paths, STOP and report exact blocker instead of unilateral edits.

## D1 FIRST — actual compatibility gate, not a restatement of designs
1. Freeze accepted main's source Git blobs/precise APIs for native RA3C ReportDraft, `report_content_hash` (H0), native ReviewDecision/ReportVersion/ShareGrant, Guard refs, source pins, HTML/editorial/renderer hashes and scope. Document which independently trusted inputs actually exist vs which would need future RA4 services (policy snapshot, verified real actor, immutable object store, trusted clock, model gateway provenance). Do not derive missing authority from a Draft object or self-certified metadata.
2. Using only trusted **synthetic** fixed sources already accepted in main, replay one real 404 single-issue private draft and one genuine 200 zero-issue coverage. Match exact ReportDraft/document/HTML bytes and original source/Guard findings; fail closed if unable. **404 is a reviewable candidate, 200 may only produce internal coverage acknowledgement with native=null, never formal APPROVE.**
3. Record D1 compatibility PASS/BLOCKED per field and precise source references. If a required trust input cannot be provided within this offline scope, implement an explicit refusal contract, not dummy provenance. Severe incompatible canonicalization/guard/source semantics → STOP before D2 and report.

## D2 — actual pure domain engine for safe review preparation / proposed decisions
1. Implement strict and versioned `ReviewTarget` builder/validator as separate sidecar from original RA0 schema. Bind H0 when non-null, complete original RA3C draft ref, native+editorial+full HTML raw SHA, asset/layout hash, independently held EvidencePack/SourcePolicy/Guard/rule/reporter/model provenance, scope/tenant/report/run/version and immutable object ref. Domain-separated canonical deterministic UTF8 SHA256; reject JSON duplicate keys/NaN/Infinity/oversized values, incorrect types, missing claims, wrong source refs, mismatched ByteRange, altered HTML/footer/CSS/version, escaped or REJECTED Guard. **A digest does not authenticate a human.**
2. Provide pure `ReviewCommandProposal` / `CoverageAcknowledgementProposal` validation plus a synthetically scoped **in-memory** review state-machine reference. Validate complete per-claim dispositions (objective facts vs hypotheses vs proposed actions), scope/limitations/full-preview acknowledgements, 1–2000 character specific reason for reject/changes, unique refs, stable version, no source mutation. No actor supplied from report/HTTP/free text is trusted.
3. Future human/session authorization must be an **unimplemented, always-denying** external port; tests may inject explicitly marked synthetic `TEST_ONLY_ACTOR` for state-machine simulation, but absolutely never produce a real native approval, durable ReviewDecision, APPROVED report, ShareGrant or any external visibility. If someone imports library in production without the future verified-auth/persistence adapter, it must fail closed. Distinguish `SIMULATED_APPROVE_CANDIDATE`, `SIMULATED_CHANGES_REQUESTED`, `SIMULATED_REJECTED`, `SIMULATED_INTERNAL_SCOPE_ACK` from actual signed/committed decisions.
4. In-memory first-writer-wins CAS demonstration (not real concurrency or durability): keyed by tenant/report/version/target_digest/review_seq; same idempotency key+same command returns immutable simulation receipt; same key+different payload or second decision denied; changing any byte, source/Guard/version/scope/policy/renderer invalidates old review and prior simulation. No old-version reactivation. Explicitly label all ledger/recovery as nondurable and do not fake transaction/outbox/clock/role revocation guarantees.
5. DO NOT call `approve_version` to generate actual `APPROVED`, DO NOT call `check_share` as a recipient or create ShareGrant; original native Draft stays PRIVATE/NOT_APPROVED/unshareable. No login, API, DB, UI changes, Worker or external service.

## Hard acceptance evidence
- Actual Python3.11 and 3.13 execution: one 404 source-bound target candidate and 200 coverage only, deterministic exact digests across runtimes; independently held source/Guard/HTML pins; original native bytes unchanged. Include at least three full end-to-end synthetic paths: possible-approval-candidate / request-changes / zero-issue ack; these are **simulated**, not genuine reviewers.
- Negative matrix includes cross-tenant/unassigned/unverified actor, model/worker actor, missing source/object, altered native H0, HTML/CSS/footnote, guard signature/binding, fake source ref, stale version, duplicate/ambiguous per-claim disposition, unsupported text, zero-to-finding, CAS collision, concurrent competing actions, partial metadata, clock missing. Fail closed and retain actual exception codes and runnable checks.
- Map the 48 original design A01–A48 to implementation coverage **without marking future real-auth/DB/production A-cases PASS**. Report explicitly which remain NOT_RUN/BLOCKED. Preserve original Phase0 untouched.
- Four new real GitHub CI jobs must complete on exact final Draft PR HEAD + latest accepted main, with dual Python and isolated original HTTP/browser unchanged; log full commands, 4 raw job statuses/checkouts and merge-ref ordered parents. Normal historical tests/Gold untouched. Submit Draft PR, final SHA, source/blob scopes, test JUnit/raw logs, limitations. NO self merge/deploy.

## Absolute boundaries
**OFFLINE_DOMAIN_CODE_GO only**. NOT actual RA3D production approval authority. Future D3 internal private UI/API and RA4 authenticated actor + DB transactional CAS/object store/audit/outbox need **another explicit Owner stage GO and separate realistic runtime proof**. Never run a live website/model, expose customer data/report, external send, share/grant/token, production install, paid calls or E2/E3. Human Gold remains 0/26 and quality not evaluable.

Owner state: `RA3D_D1_D2_OFFLINE_DOMAIN_CODE_GO / RA3D_AUTHENTICATED_PRODUCTION_REVIEW_NO_GO / CUSTOMER_SHARE_NO_GO / HUMAN_GOLD_0_OF_26`.
